crossRefs.note: I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan. You have been very pleasant to me. Your love to me was wonderful, passing…
But these things don’t count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the…
according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always…

people.name: Mephibosheth
people.line: Son of Jonathan and grandson of King Saul.

translations.web: Mephibosheth said to the king, “Yes, let him take all, because my lord the king has come in peace to his own house.”
translations.bsb: And Mephibosheth said to the king, “Instead, since my lord the king has safely come to his own house, let Ziba take it all!”
translations.kjv: And Mephibosheth said unto the king, Yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come again in peace unto his own house.
translations.asv: And Mephibosheth said unto the king, yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come in peace unto his own house.
